description: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature, Implement, and live session Audit workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Traverse graph-first Learn, Idea, Feature, Implement, and Audit workflows.
interface.longDescription: SE2 is an experimental issue-first, graph-first plugin with explicit durable-context, Idea capture, Feature planning, GitHub-Feature-to-PR implementation, and live session Audit entry points. Learn performs only authorized local-repository context changes and has no external dependency preflight. Idea publishes hosted Ideas by default through G, with local preview as an opt-in. Feature consolidates caller-proposed splits into the smallest independently deliverable repository boundary, then converges authoritative Feature issues, vertical Task issues, stable bracketed acceptance-criterion IDs, acyclic Task dependency graphs, and an explicit terminal preview/publish/reconciliation subgraph with publish as the default. Idea, Feature, and Implement share one portable-content safety gate immediately before every hosted write; SE2 owns semantic projection while G owns transport and readback. Implement coordinates a Sol/medium control plane with one adaptive Sol Feature Worker, isolated worktree, branch, and PR per implementation-eligible Feature; each Feature Worker executes its complete Task DAG serially and binds every criterion to one final exact HEAD. Parallelism and standalone or stacked delivery topology exist only across Features, while zero-delta or defective contracts route through Feature Contract Repair without artificial commits or PRs. Implement consumes exact-head provider readiness from G's delivery-status workflow, maps Git and GitHub transport to G-owned workflows, gates stacked children on a green exact-HEAD parent, reconciles parent drift, and keeps a minimal SQLite WAL recovery ledger. Provider automation and bypass capabilities never authorize Implement to merge, enqueue, or change auto-merge state. An explicit SE2 GitHub request implicitly authorizes the exact in-scope hosted writes required by its selected workflow; merge, deploy, release, and post-merge closure remain outside the default scope. Audit observes active SE2 sessions read-only, reconstructs workflow-graph conformance from positive evidence, and reports feedback, bugs, regressions, graph violations, and graph-design improvements without persistent state. Root contracts standardize graph vocabulary, live task preflight, destination and identity observation, bounded display-title reconciliation, update relay, and recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $se2:learn for durable repository knowledge or $se2:idea for transient capture and explicit GitHub publication.
Use $se2:feature to consolidate candidate boundaries into minimal Features with Task DAGs or repair Feature contracts.
Use $se2:implement for one Feature Worker and one PR per Feature, or $se2:audit to monitor SE2 graph runs read-only.
